title: Evaluation of the equal-value completion tree
statement: Let $R_1,R_2,B_3$ be finite sets of coordinates in a finite coordinate space, with $R_1$ disjoint from $R_2\cup B_3$ and $R_2$ disjoint from $B_3$. Let $C_1$ and $C_2$ assign to each sign a decision tree using coordinates in $R_1$ and $R_2$, respectively, and let $E_3$ be a decision tree using coordinates in $B_3$. For a sign $x_1$ and any sign assignment $x$ on the coordinate space, the tree formed by the equal-value completion construction evaluates to the first two tree outputs if they agree, and otherwise to the output of $E_3$.
